name: HFD DataVita Limited
ownership_summary: Incorporated 2014-01-15 as DataVita Limited; renamed HFD DataVita Limited. PSC since 2024-05-01 is HFD Technology Group Limited (SC806309); previously HFD Group Limited (SC362322) 2021-2024, HFD Managements Ltd (SC234591) 2019-2021, and founder William Dale Hill 2016-2019. Registered office 177 Bothwell Street, Glasgow G2 7ER.

name: HFD Technology Group Limited
ownership_summary: Registered person with significant control of HFD DataVita Limited since 1 May 2024 (75%+ shares and votes, right to appoint/remove directors); HFD Group's technology division holding company.

name: HFD Group
ownership_summary: Wider family-owned property/renewables/technology group (HFD Group Limited was PSC of DataVita 2021-2024); DataVita is described as HFD's data centre/technology division. Group also spans HFD Property and HFD Renewables divisions.
notes: Committed £1m annually to local charities under the AI Growth Zone announcement.

name: CoreWeave
notes: September 2025 announcement: CoreWeave to deploy NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Ultra GPUs 'at DataVita's Lanarkshire campus' as part of a £1.5bn UK commitment. This is an announced commitment/partnership, not a disclosed signed colocation contract; which building(s) host the deployment has not been published.
